actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 connects to a login prompt, and block until it is ready.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process attached to /app/alpine.iso
required_behaviors: QEMU must be started in the background
Port 6665 on localhost must accept telnet connections
Connection should present a login prompt
known_invalid_patterns: Only checking that QEMU launched without confirming telnet readiness
Treating non-empty output or compile/smoke checks as success
verification_plan: Launch QEMU with serial/console redirected to a telnet-accessible TCP port 6665
Probe localhost:6665 until the service is reachable
Confirm the connection reaches a login prompt before finalizing
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence that QEMU was started with /app/alpine.iso
Receipt-backed evidence that the reachable service presents a login prompt
